comments.body: 2026-11-13, Codex 0.167.2: /new and its worktree choice emit no lifecycle hook, SessionEnd included; the new id arrives only with the first prompt's SessionStart, and the title does not change. No safe signal to clear the old resume id. Recorded in corpus/codex-0.167.2/new-conversation.txt and docs/observations/codex-0.167.2.md section 3 (aca703e2).
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the 2026-11-05 recordings of /new (Codex 0.166.0): Codex reports a new conversation's id only at its first prompt, so until then the pane still holds the old id, and muster pane restart resumes that old conversation rather than the empty new one. Typed delivery (276936d9) cannot discover an unreported composer either. Low stakes since agents are now told to restart a pane rather than /new, but a person can still do it. Evidence: the worker's /private/tmp/muster-codex-ownership.* recordings on the Mac mini.
title: Restarting a Codex pane after /new, before its first prompt, resumes the conversation just left
